Name: Otter's Additional Coop Animals
Author: Otterlyadorable
Description:
[center][/center][center][b][u]﻿﻿﻿Disclaimer:[/u][/b]
[color=#ff0000]Please don't re-upload or re-distribute or edit/trace over my Mod/ Sprites at all and especially not behind a paywall! It would be very disrespectful of my efforts and work plus it's not a nice thing to do. This was done just so I could practice doing sprites and is meant to be free to enjoy and not for profit. [/color]
[color=#ff0000]They may not be amazing but I did work hard on them. [/color]
[color=#ff0000]Please don't add any of my stuff to Mod Packs even with credit. People barely read the credits and it kinda takes away from this mod and the possibility for feedback. If you would like to, for whatever reason, contact me and ask first! I would like to check out the mod first and maybe help push it.[/color]
[color=#ff0000]This mod should only be available for download here on Nexus and on the Stardew Valley mod forum under the username "thatotterthing".[/color]

[b]As usual these are done on an attempt to keep to Stardew valley's style. The good may change in the future but for now that's what ya get! Thank you for checking out the mod. As usual I am open to comments and suggestions and please don't be shy about mentioning any bugs! Some of these guys will be in the upcoming pet mod as well! [/b]
[color=#f4f4f4]
[u]Instructions:[/u]
⦁ Install SMAPI
⦁ Install Content Patcher
⦁ Extract into your \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder (or wherever you installed your SMAPI mods folder)
⦁ ﻿You can Purchase these animals from Marnie when she's Open![/color][/center]
